Bill.BriefDescription: Protecting privacy rights regarding animal identification.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to privacy rights regarding animal identificationinformation; and adding a new section to chapter 16.36 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 16.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Neither the state, the agency, nor the director may restrict,limit, or infringe upon the personal or private property rights ofindividuals, corporations, or other entities whether they choose toparticipate or not in premise registration or animal identificationprograms.
